title: Inventory & Fulfillment API E2E (private-app example)
description: Minimal runnable starter Private App: quarantine location (PUT /inventory/locations/{locationId}, isFulfillable: false), atomic WMS batch (POST /inventory/movements), absolute reconciliation (PUT /inventory/levels), sales-velocity report (GET /reports), signed inventory.changed verification, and synthetic preview orders (tot app test-order create).
